name: Fi Silverthorn
biography: Training Fi Silverthorn is a performer, choreographer and movement director. She trained at The Urdang Academy and Broadway Dance Center, New York. Theatre For the National Theatre: Bacchae In London’s West End: Impressions at London Coliseum; and & Juliet at West End Live Other theatre includes: Blaze – The Streetdance Spectacular on European tour; NOX at the Young Vic; What is BirdGang? and Vicycle at Sadler’s Wells; Vice at Denver Arts Centre; FRAY Show at Lillian Baylis; Orphée at The Vache and Buxton Fringe; Principles of Deception at the Royal & Derngate; and with artists including FKA Twigs, Ellie Goulding and Alexandra Burke at Royal Albert Hall TV MOBO Awards, Strictly Come Dancing, Saudi Games Opening Ceremony and Comic Relief Film Better Man and StreetDancer 3D Events Budweiser World Cup Launch at Wembley Arena; Step Up 3 series launch; Lollapalooza Festival, Berlin; Wilderness Festival; Off the Rails film premiere; London Fashion Week; and four UK arena tours Fi Silverthorn has produced choreography for various adverts, Realness – The Musical and was an associate choreographer on Arte for Celebrity Cruises. She is a street dance specialist and core member of BirdGang Dance Company, with 18 years of experience training in street dance art forms. (Published September 2025. Photo: Talie Eigeland) Source: National Theatre
